visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled black hair, wearing an open white shirt over a white tank top and grey trousers, stands on a paved city sidewalk. He holds a black microphone with a visible 'RØDE' logo and speaks to the camera with an animated expression. (2) The scene transitions to a glass storefront with '1010 APOTHECARY' signage. The glass reflects passing traffic and features colorful interior graphics. (3) Inside a brightly lit store, the man stands at a red display counter. He picks up a clear perfume bottle and shows it to the camera while gesturing with his hands. (4) A second man in a grey shirt enters the frame. They both stand by the counter, examining perfume bottles and a paper test strip that changes color when sprayed. (5) Close-up shots focus on various products, including a black oval-shaped solid perfume case and incense sticks on a counter. The men interact with these objects, demonstrating their use. (6) The video concludes with the man back in the store environment, gesturing broadly towards the shelves of cosmetics and waving goodbye to the camera.
